query:
SELECT state_name, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status, rating, primary_date, general_date 
FROM senate_races 
WHERE state_name IN ('West Virginia', 'Nebraska')
UNION ALL
SELECT state_name, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status, rating, primary_date, general_date 
FROM house_races 
WHERE state_name IN ('West Virginia', 'Nebraska')
ORDER BY state_name;
